newsitem.title: USA: St. Louis bus crash kills two.
newsitem.headline: St. Louis bus crash kills two.

text.p: At least two people were killed and several were injured when a bus hit a boarding platform on Wednesday, police said.
The accident happened at Normandy, a suburb north and west of downtown, on the campus of the University of Missouri at St. Louis.
Police said the Bi-State bus ran into a platform on which people were waiting to board MetroLink, the area's light rail transit system.
Unconfirmed reports said there were six injuries in addition to the two deaths.
